Palestinian journalist Samer Khuwaira was brought before Judge Kamel Zaher al-Din at the Shomron military court. Khuwaira was released from prison a year ago after being detained without trial for nine months. Like 3,000 other administrative detainees, he doesn't know what the suspicions against him were, given that no indictment had been filed. Like all other security prisoners, during his detention he suffered from the food deprivation policy adopted by the Prison Service, losing 22 kilograms (45 pounds) in weight, as well as contracting scabies.
